profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Splunk
profile.summary: Gabriel J Mendoza is a passionate Software Engineer/Developer who loves to solve tough problems. His expertise comes mainly in the backend, but has enterprise experience working on the full-stack. Gabriel is a leader, and this was exemplified on multiple occasions, like when he took on the tech lead role in not only his Senior Design Project (RoboSub) and in the IBM New Hire Developers Project (Calculate the Best Time to Send), but also UKG's initiatives to transition all applications to K8s (Hosted in GCP) and integrate and reverse-engineer a third-party acquired product with a very aggressive roll-out timeline. Gabriel is nit-picky - doesn't stop until the job is done the correct way - and doesn't like to leave things unfinished.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Leveraged prior work experience with Java, MySQL, and Memcached databases, as well as developing REST APIs to quickly onboard and become a high-output team member.
• Improved on data validation throughout the CRM
• Led and designed project related to applying AI-generated regular expressions for property validation

Languages/Frameworks: Java, Kafka, DropWizard

Impact:
• Identified and resolved several long-standing bugs.
• Accelerated high impact project to allow for custom translations by quickly ramping up and tackling several high priority tasks.
• Reduced total week over week errors by 95%.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Large Language Models (LLM) · Software Development · Generative AI Tools · Claude Skills · Anthropic Claude

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Gained experience leading projects as a Senior Engineer.
• Worked primarily in the backend, gaining experience using Golang, Java, MSSQL, Mongo, MySQL, and Redis databases, and developing REST APIs.

Languages/Frameworks: Golang, ReactJS, Angular, Docker, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, MSSQL, MySQL

Impact:
• Successfully migrated all microservices to K8s for GCP migration.
• Improved application monitoring by implementing Prometheus metrics
tied to Grafana alerts.
• Contributed to improving the performance and scalability of the product.
• Designed and led implementation on a solution to create a seamless integration between an owned application and a recently acquired third-party application.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Software Development · Docker · Git · Systems Design · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Communication · Java · System Performance · Developer Tools · Attention to Detail

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Gained experience with Agile and Test-Driven Software Development methodologies.
• Worked primarily in the backend, gaining experience using Oracle, Mongo, and Redis databases and developing REST APIs.

Languages/Frameworks: Java, Spring (MVC and Boot), Hibernate, NodeJS, ReactJS, Angular, Docker

Impact:
• Awarded the annual Manager's Choice Award, twice.
• Obtained the IBM Design Thinking Certif ication.
• Improved productivity by automating many day-to-day,
time-consuming, and manual tasks.
• Contributed to improving the performance and scalability of the product.
